Title: Omi: AI-powered Contract and Vendor Management | Product Hunt
## AI-powered Contract and Vendor Management. Omi is an AI-powered document management platform made for finance & operations teams. Consolidate all contract in one place, get notified on renewals and action items, and easily search and collaborate on contracts and vendors. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Omi. 👋 We’re excited to launch Omi, an easy to use interface that automatically parses contracts & documents and keeps an updated summary so you can easily manage contracts and never miss a renewal. 🚀 If you manage any contracts, vendor agreements, external contractors, leases, agencies, recruiters, etc., Omi will: 📄 Parse all of your contract automatically 📅 Provide you with a summary of amounts, renewal dates, billing/payment terms, etc. 🟢 Help you track which ones are active and expired 💬 Start a Slack channel with relevant team members to discuss renewal 📊 Analyze contract vs. actuals so you can see budget & spend We also make the process of managing contracts more collaborative with calendar invites & Slack channels that automatically remind you when you have a $120K software subscription due. For v1 of this product, we’re excited to introduce a Free & $99/mo plan (50% off 3mo for Product Hunters). If you have a folder of disorganized contracts sitting somewhere, we’d love for you to try us out. Let us know what you think when you try it out. Congrats on the launch, Omi team! Do you offer free trial for users on the $99 plan? you can start with a free trial and upgrade if you like the tool, we have a promo code for 50% off 3mo. Love all the wrap-around services for activating and managing the contracts (i.e. tracking renewals, analyzing budget vs spend). Would love to hear what you think when you try it out. It seems like you're focusing on larger contracts that require negotiations? Would love to see all the small subscriptions in one place too! This is really interesting and would be a great tool for a bunch of my startup clients who don't have the time to manage all multiple contracts and vendor. Would love to get their feedback when they try it.
